BUYING A PARROT FROM CROWNWING

A remarkable companion.
A considered beginning.

Explore the available range, understand the care commitment and contact Crownwing for current bird details. We are a parrot breeder and retailer; choosing well starts with the individual, not just the species.

1. Explore the range. Understand the species.

All eight parrot groups are available through Crownwing. Start with Available birds to choose a group, then read our species guides for lifespan, diet, housing and everyday care. Guide photographs illustrate species; they are not a live stock catalogue.

2. Request current details of the actual bird.

Individual birds change regularly. Contact us for current photographs, age, background, diet, handling and price. Share your experience, available space and daily routine so your enquiry covers more than availability.

3. Confirm the details before you commit.

Ask about any records, care information and supplies included with the bird. Agree payment terms, viewing and collection arrangements directly. Ask what aftercare is offered; do not assume a service or guarantee that has not been confirmed.

4. Have the home ready for the first day.

Plan appropriate accommodation, familiar food, safe exercise and enrichment, and identify an avian vet. Read the parrot buying checklist and home preparation guide before making arrangements.
